title: sql.gleam adds Viewed type variant + encoder arm but no decoder arm
evidence:
+  Viewed
   Shortlisted
   UnderReview
   Submitted
...
+    Viewed -> "viewed"
     Shortlisted -> "shortlisted"

(spec, in same diff:) "+- `server/src/application/sql.gleam` — Squirrel-generated `ApplicationStatus` type + `application_status_encoder` (regenerated, NOT hand-edited)"
detail: The only two sql.gleam hunks add the Viewed variant and its encoder arm; no decoder arm appears. If a generated application_status decoder exists here, SELECT of viewed rows silently hits its default arm — compile-safe but runtime-broken.
recommended_fix: Verify Squirrel regenerated the decoder too; if an application_status_decoder exists, add the "viewed" -> Viewed arm so DB reads of viewed statuses decode correctly.
